title: Show HN: CheapFoodMap – A map of good meals under $10
summary: CheapFoodMap is a crowdsourced map application that helps users find quality meals under $10 at local restaurants (excluding franchises). Created by someone laid off after 18 years as a 100-day challenge, it covers 1200 meals across 15 US cities with heaviest coverage in Texas.
problem_solved: Helps budget-conscious people find affordable, high-quality local meals during times of economic uncertainty
why_valuable: Provides a practical solution for people facing financial constraints to discover hidden gem restaurants at affordable prices
